setup.UL_gap_normalised: w^2 (w+2)^2 + (theta - theta^2)^2   (= w-part of F + c * theta-part of F); used for ranking
setup.grid: eta = 0.027 c * {0.3,0.6,0.9,1.3,2,3} (+4.5 if 3 is best), gamma in {0.5,1}, eta_gamma in {0.012,0.017}, K=1; same relative grid at every c
setup.score: mean over iterations of log10 max(median UL gap, median LL gap); any divergence disqualifies
